references.text: The description of the tabernacle curtains (יְרִיעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן) that the sons of Gershon were to carry, found here with detailed instructions on how they should be made.
The instructions for the covering of the tent of meeting (אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד) made of goat hair mentioned in Numbers 4:25.
Describes the covering of red dyed ram skins and badger skins (מִכְסֵה הַתַּחַשׁ) that was to be the top layer on the tabernacle.
The actual execution of the work with the curtains and coverings described in chapter 26, which the sons of Gershon were later to transport.
The screen for the entrance of the tent (מָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד) mentioned explicitly in Numbers 4:25.
Summarizes the main parts of the tabernacle including the curtains, the covering, and the screen that the sons of Gershon were to carry.
The earlier description of the responsibility of the sons of Gershon at the tent of meeting, which is elaborated in more detail in chapter 4.
The carts and oxen given to the sons of Gershon to transport the tabernacle curtains and coverings mentioned in 4:25.
